criteria.description: Primary shell and mega reach every documented state: desktop hover/click open-close with pin, keyboard Enter/Space, Escape with focus return from summary and from focused destinations, outside/destination/mobile/breakpoint close, same-breakpoint resize stability, mobile activation-only panel

Exactly one brand, four top entries (3 plain + 1 disclosure), two category groups, ten title-only category destinations, one promo title/description/CTA/square media, two actions, one named toggle, one chevron — no unused sublinks, social/footer inventions, or duplicate trees

Desktop full-width logo-left / links / end-actions bar with full-band absolute mega (categories beside promo); mobile top row logo+toggle only with links and stacked full-width actions below when open; 320/340, 767/768/769 seams
One landmark/tree, visible focus, fully visible 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark tokens, axe WCAG 2.1 AA, JS-disabled usability
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
